card.statement:
Let $\varepsilon=\pm 1$ and $N>0$ such that $\varepsilon^{N}=1$. Let $\lambda\in\mathcal{P}_{\varepsilon}(N)$ be an even partition, and let $\sigma$ be the shift matrix determined by $\lambda$, as in Lemma 2.1. Pick a $(-\varepsilon(-1)^{\lambda_{1}},\sigma)$ -admissible shape and let $\tau:\mathfrak{c}_{n}(\sigma)\to\mathfrak{c}_{n}(\sigma)$ be the the involution (5.25). Abusing notation we also write $\tau:\mathfrak{gl}_{N}\to\mathfrak{gl}_{N}$ for the automorphism described in (4.12).

(1)

There is a surjective Lie algebra homomorphism

$\displaystyle\mathfrak{c}_{n}(\sigma)$ $\displaystyle\relbar\joinrel\twoheadrightarrow$ $\displaystyle\mathfrak{gl}_{N}^{e}$

$\displaystyle e_{a,i,b,j}t^{r}$ $\displaystyle\longmapsto$ $\displaystyle c_{a,i,b,j}^{(r)}$

where $c_{a,i,b,j}^{(r)}:=0$ for $r\geq s_{a,b}+\min(\lambda_{a},\lambda_{b})$. The kernel is Poisson generated by $e_{1,i,1,j}t^{r}$ with $r\geq\lambda_{1}$, $1\leq i,j\leq\nu_{1}$

(2)

The homomorphism from (1) restricts to $\mathfrak{c}_{n}(\sigma)^{\tau}\twoheadrightarrow(\mathfrak{g}^{e})^{\tau}$.

(i)

For $\varepsilon=1$ the kernel is generated as a Lie ideal by

(5.43)

$\displaystyle\{\eta_{1,i,j;r}\mid r\geq\lambda_{1}\ ,1\leq i,j\leq\nu_{1}\}$

(ii)

For $\varepsilon=-1$ and $\nu_{1}\neq 1$ the kernel is generated by (5.43)

(iii)

For $\varepsilon=-1$ and $\nu_{1}=1$ the kernel is generated by those elements, along with

(5.44)

$\displaystyle\{\theta_{1,i,j;\lambda_{1}+s_{1,2}}\mid 1\leq i\leq\nu_{1},\ 1\leq j\leq\nu_{2}\}.$
card.label: Lemma 5.5

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and Slodowy slices in classical Lie algebras
paper.abstract: In this paper we introduce the shifted twisted Yangian of type {\sf AI}, following the work of Lu--Wang--Zhang, and we study their semiclassical limits, a class of Poisson algebras. We demonstrate that they coincide with the Dirac reductions of the semiclassical shifted Yangian for $\mathfrak{gl}_n$. We deduce that these shifted twisted Yangians admit truncations which are isomorphic to Slodowy slices for many non-rectangular nilpotent elements in types {\sf B}, {\sf C}, {\sf D}. As a direct consequence we obtain parabolic presentations of the semiclassical shifted twisted Yangian, analogous to those introduced by Brundan--Kleshchev for the Yangian of type {\sf A}. Finally we give Poisson presentations of Slodowy slices for all even nilpotent elements in types {\sf B}, {\sf C}, {\sf D}, generalising the recent work of the second author.
